name: io.github.fabioc-aloha/youtube-mcp-tools
title: YouTube MCP Tools
description: Evidence-first YouTube research, transcript analysis, segment intelligence, and collateral generation.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: YouTube Data API v3 key. Required for search, metadata, analysis, flashcards, and live topic research; not required for transcript tools.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_MCP_DIRECT_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Optional direct-generation provider. Supported value: openai-compatible.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_MCP_DIRECT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the explicitly configured direct-generation provider.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_MCP_DIRECT_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional model name for the configured direct-generation provider.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_MCP_DIRECT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible API base URL for the configured direct-generation provider.
